passFindings: ⚠️⚠️ THE CATALOG IS COMPLETE: 27 of 27 traditions, 285 of 285 crafts. Twelve antipode pairs plus three folk traditions (radiant, harmonic, valley_craft), all authored against the locked CCODE-64 schema.

⚠️ SNG-261 §B IS RESHAPED BY `old_roads`, AND THIS IS THE MOST IMPORTANT SINGLE FINDING OF THE WHOLE PASS. It is a T-II craft in the OPEN-ACCESS FOLK tradition that senses Precursor material, maps a site by walking it, judges whether a remnant is DORMANT/CYCLING/WAKING, and at r3 perceives the VALLEY'S WHOLE LATTICE and knows when it CHANGES. SNG-011's fourth access route — 'OLD ROADS MASTERY' — IS NAMED AFTER THIS CRAFT. Precursor contact was never a locked door: THE VALLEY'S ORDINARY PEOPLE HAVE A CRAFT FOR IT. With prism_sight, echo_memory, mech_sense, command_engine, enginecraft, tinkers_hand, beastfriend and stonewise, that is NINE independent in-catalog precursor hooks — and the folk one is the broadest. The epistemic shape is also better than a door: the folk can SENSE it, MAP it and know when it MOVES, and its PURPOSE stays dark.

VALLEY_CRAFT IS THE MOST MECHANICALLY SPECIFIC TRADITION IN THE CATALOG, and it is not close: '+2 extra health and energy overnight', 'travel time -1h', 'once per day', 'once per season', 'once per location per visit' — stated outright in the source. Where a pole writes 'revelation at scale', the folk tradition writes '+2'. That is exactly right, and it made this file nearly pure transcription.

hearthbinding IS THE ARGUMENT FOR WHAT A FOLK TRADITION IS FOR. It makes CAMP a mechanic, turns a shared meal into a truce hostile parties will keep, and after three nights NAMES A PLACE INTO THE WORLD'S MEMORY. No pole tradition has anything remotely like it — because no pole tradition is about ordinary people staying alive together. If Erik's foothills ask (item 26) needs a north star, this craft is it.

THE FOLK TRADITION IS THE STRICTEST IN THE CATALOG ABOUT CONSENT: beastfriend's three HARD bounds all say the same thing — 'NO COMMANDS, ONLY TRUST'; 'a partner, NOT A TOOL'; 'YOU ASK — ALWAYS. NOTHING HERE IS COMPELLED.' And greenlore's healing is bounded by 'IT HAS TO BE TAKEN, WHICH MEANS IT HAS TO BE GIVEN.' Thirteen traditions now refuse coercion mechanically, and the ordinary people are the most absolute about it.

hunters_strike IS THE T-I DAMAGE BASELINE ERIK'S ORIGINAL BENCHMARK WAS ABOUT ('a T-I strike at max should kill a T-I beast'), and its three HARD bounds are all ETHICAL rather than mechanical: 'no warrior's forms — one target, honest force'; 'CLEAN IS A DISCIPLINE, NOT A MERCY — the animal is still dead'; 'it is a hunter's craft, NOT A SOLDIER'S — turned on people IT IS WHAT IT IS.' The baseline damage craft of the entire game refuses to be comfortable about killing.

A NINETEENTH DEFENSIVE LOGIC — UNREMARKED (blend_in): not stealth, not concealment, not misdirection, but BEING UNWORTH NOTICING. Its cost bound is the saddest small line in the catalog: 'being forgettable means being FORGOTTEN — Valleyfolk who lean on this lose things.' Nineteen logics, still THREE mechanisms (Erik's grouping, item 28, holds).

A FOURTEENTH THEORY OF MEDICINE — HERBAL (greenlore): small, reliable, over a rest. Fourteen traditions, fourteen incompatible theories of what healing IS, one `healing` shape carrying every one of them. That is the strongest single piece of evidence that the CCODE-64 schema generalises.

THE FINAL CRAFT'S FINAL BOUND IS THE WHOLE TRADITION IN ONE LINE: boundary_stone — 'THE OLD BOUNDARIES WERE SET BY PEOPLE WHO PAID FOR THEM.' A folk ward that works because someone, once, was willing to stand behind a claim. A good place for the catalog to end.
